MR Safety
MR Conditional (1.5 Tesla only): spatial field gradient ≤ 1,000 Gauss/cm; slew rate ≤ 150 T/m/s per axis; Whole-Body SAR ≤ 4 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode; Use the body transmit coil.
Device configuration during MRI: MRI mode ON.
Image artifact: up to 5 mm.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
